basic_info.description: Welcome to 40 Gambier Street, a charming gem in the vibrant Portola neighborhood. This 4 bed, 2 bath home spans 1,502 square feet of inviting living space. Upstairs, you'll find 3 cozy bedrooms and a updated kitchen & bathroom, while downstairs features an additional bedroom, lounge room, and a full bathroom. Fresh interior paint complements the updated kitchen, perfect for culinary adventures. Enjoy partial city views that add a touch of magic to your everyday life. Located just a stroll away from San Bruno Avenue's bustling shops and eateries, and McLaren Park for your outdoor adventures. With convenient walking distance to Muni and easy freeway access, your new home perfectly balances tranquility and city life.
